ask: can u look over my clinic thing and make it not embarrassing lol. investors tmrw
notes: Casual voice, time pressure, 'not embarrassing' is vague. Fix mode is implied ('make it'). A good intake reads 'not embarrassing' as P1 and P2 fixed and keeps the round short. Quick is a fair recommendation too.
message:
I will review every screen of your clinic prototype, fix what looks careless, and give you before and after screenshots to look at before the investors do.

**Found:**
- Prototype: `proto-clinic/index.html`, the only one in this folder.
- Screens: Today, Clients, Invoices, Settings (the nav's own labels).
- It will be fixed in place, with a copy of every changed file kept. Nothing is deployed or sent.
- It is for the investor meeting tomorrow.
- The browser and the file both work, so the check can run.
- The full plan is in `loop-runs/product-review-loop-20261126-035319/brief.md`.

**Track:** full, because the meeting is tomorrow and phones are worth a look.

Still open after reading your files: who the screens are for, and what counts as your call.

**Done means:**
- All 4 screens have a before and an after screenshot.
- A fresh reviewer finds no big problem left on any screen.
- Any big problem I did not fix is listed first, with one sentence.
- Every big and medium problem is fixed or has a reason.
- Every changed file has its original kept.

About 25 minutes and 4 helper agents, within a budget of 60 minutes.

1. Who will look at this tomorrow, and what should they come away with?
   Recommended: investors who see a physio clinic receptionist booking appointments and checking who has paid.
   Why it matters: it decides which screen I polish hardest and what counts as broken.

2. Should I fix medium problems too, or only the big ones?
   Recommended: fix both. Small polish is listed for you and never changed.
   Why it matters: "not embarrassing" usually needs the medium ones as well, such as a dead button or an empty list with no message.

3. Quick (big problems only, desktop width) or full (also phone width)?
   Recommended: full, about 25 minutes.
   Why it matters: quick is faster but will miss anything that breaks on a phone.

4. Anything you want left alone, or any rule of your own?
   Recommended: none. Colours, fonts, the clinic name and the layout are listed for you to decide, and I change none of them.
   Why it matters: you stay in control of the look.

Reply with your answers, or just "go" to use the defaults.
